pr_title: Fix color picker unusable on Linux
pr_body:
This PR fixes this issue:
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/100797
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/101328

And might also fix this one (I can't tell if it's fixed because I cannot reproduce it on my own computer.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/101412

Cheers
pr_comments:
> And might also fix this one (I can't tell if it's fixed because I cannot reproduce it on my own computer.
> #101412

I can reproduce this issue (Fedora 41, KDE Wayland, using the X11 build of Godot on a single monitor with multi-windows enabled), and this PR doesn't fix it sadly.

So the color picker for me is still (critically) unusable. I can't assess whether this PR fixes the other two issues but it seems they might already be fixed? Maybe you compared 4.4.dev7 with this PR, instead of latest master with this PR?

The code cleanup seems fine but if it's not actually fixing bugs we should clarify that.

I see you're missing #101266 in your `fork_master` branch, which might explain the discrepancies. I wonder why it doesn't show merge conflicts on GitHub as this code definitely changed.

*Edit:* I was wrong, #101266 is in that branch.

> > And might also fix this one (I can't tell if it's fixed because I cannot reproduce it on my own computer.
> > #101412
> 
> I can reproduce this issue (Fedora 41, KDE Wayland, using the X11 build of Godot on a single monitor with multi-windows enabled), and this PR doesn't fix it sadly.

Actually #101412 is a regression from #101266 ~which is missing in your branch, which is likely why you're not reproducing it.~

*Edit:* Sorry I'm a bit confused, it does seem to be present in @xsellier's branch. But I _assume_ when they tested they didn't have that PR in their local branch, and they later rebased.

* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/101328 it removes this line which is causing a flicker in editor multi-window mode, and also it fixes the popup position based on the current focused screen, but it's not fixing https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/101412.

> is a regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/101266 which is missing in your branch, which is likely why you're not reproducing it.

Yeah I was just confused because #101266 added a lot more `Vector2i(26, 26)` (note `i`) and this PR only changed a couple `Vector2(26, 26)`, and when searching for them in the file I didn't find more occurrences. But that's because of the `Vector2`/`Vector2i` inconsistency.

issue_context.title: [v4.4.dev7] Color picker is unusable and flashes rapidly between black and white
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.dev7, was working in 4.4.dev6
- Introduced in 9fece033ab11b97bb1c3b1ddeca7b5a21bab0771, where changes to the color picker were made

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev (9fece033a) - Linux Mint 22 (Wilma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (nvidia; 550.120) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

Edit: The problem seems to be specific to Linux.

It's no longer possible to pick any colors with the color picker. Using it spawns a box under the cursor which rapidly flickers back and forth between black and white.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1cf5bacb-5d1e-4e85-a97f-e0e1435048dc

### Steps to reproduce

- Open any color picker (2D, 3D, doesn't matter)
- Hover over anything

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
comments: Cannot reproduce on Windows 11, probably a Linux-related issue.
Can confirm this happens . But strangely enough only in editor. The in game colour picker sort of freezes the screen but still allows colours to be selected properly
Thank you both for looking into it. I can't reproduce it on Windows either, so it really seems to be specific to Linux.
Should be already fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/101266 (native X11 specific issue).

review_comments: The only relevant change is removal of this line, which is redundant, but should not have any significant effect (window position reset later, but I guess can cause some flicker).
I agree, the other changes are more linting than fixes.
The only relevant change is removal of this line, which is redundant, but should not have any significant effect (window position reset later, but I guess can cause some flicker).
I agree, the other changes are more linting than fixes.
There's a bunch more hardcoded values like this in ColorPicker, like `Vector2i(55, 72)` in the `else` branches where `28, 28` is used. It seems a bit weird to special case this one.
I also suggest removing it, unless it will be used to correctly change the popup offset.
Indeed, it probably better to remove it, it's not related to the fix, and if we want to use constants instead of hardcoded sizes/offsets the rest of the values should be changed as well.

I want to improve the code quality of the code I change/write. I don't change something that works without a valid reason.

from my POV, having magic numbers is a bad practice, and should be avoided. Even if the rest of the code keeps using magic numbers, I'd rather start using constant than keep using Magic Numbers.

I'm ok with this PR not merged if you disagree.
